role: Agentic hypervisors and sandboxes for autonomous AI systems.

ontology.api: hv2_agent::mcp::McpServer::list_tools(&AgentCapabilities) — the tool surface, filtered by the capabilities the caller holds

capabilities.name: vm.create
capabilities.description: Create a new virtual machine. Requires: VmManage.

capabilities.name: vm.start
capabilities.description: Start a virtual machine. Requires: VmWrite.

capabilities.name: vm.stop
capabilities.description: Stop a virtual machine (graceful shutdown). Requires: VmWrite.

capabilities.name: vm.pause
capabilities.description: Pause a running virtual machine, freezing its vCPUs while retaining memory state. Requires: VmWrite.

capabilities.name: vm.resume
capabilities.description: Resume a paused virtual machine, restoring vCPU execution from frozen memory state. Requires: VmWrite.

capabilities.name: vm.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a virtual machine and its resources. Requires: VmManage.

capabilities.name: vm.list
capabilities.description: List all virtual machines. Requires: VmRead.

capabilities.name: vm.status
capabilities.description: Get detailed status of a virtual machine. Requires: VmRead.

capabilities.name: vm.resize
capabilities.description: Resize VM resources (CPU, memory). Requires: VmWrite.

capabilities.name: vm.metrics
capabilities.description: Get resource usage metrics for a VM. Requires: MetricsRead.

capabilities.name: snapshot.create
capabilities.description: Create a VM snapshot. Requires: SnapshotManage.

capabilities.name: snapshot.restore
capabilities.description: Restore a VM from snapshot. Requires: SnapshotManage.

capabilities.name: snapshot.list
capabilities.description: List snapshots for a VM. Requires: VmRead.

capabilities.name: network.attach
capabilities.description: Attach a network interface to a VM. Requires: NetworkAdmin.

capabilities.name: network.detach
capabilities.description: Detach a network interface from a VM. Requires: NetworkAdmin.

capabilities.name: gpu.register
capabilities.description: Register a GPU device into the fabric inventory so it can be allocated to VMs. Requires: Admin.

capabilities.name: gpu.list
capabilities.description: List GPU devices in the fabric and their allocation status. Requires: MetricsRead.

capabilities.name: gpu.attach
capabilities.description: Attach a free GPU device to a VM, reserving it for that VM. Requires: VmWrite.

capabilities.name: gpu.detach
capabilities.description: Detach a GPU device from a VM and return it to the available pool. Requires: VmWrite.

capabilities.name: guest.exec
capabilities.description: Execute a command inside the VM guest. Requires: GuestExec.

capabilities.name: guest.exec.status
capabilities.description: Poll the result of a submitted guest request (guest.exec / guest.file.*). Requires: GuestExec.

capabilities.name: guest.file.read
capabilities.description: Read a file from inside the VM. Requires: GuestExec.

capabilities.name: guest.file.write
capabilities.description: Write a file inside the VM. Requires: GuestExec.

capabilities.name: agent.broadcast
capabilities.description: Broadcast a message to other agents. Requires: Coordination.

capabilities.name: agent.send
capabilities.description: Send a message to a specific agent. Requires: Coordination.

capabilities.name: agent.list
capabilities.description: List connected agents. Requires: Coordination.

capabilities.name: agent.claim
capabilities.description: Claim exclusive access to a VM (prevents other agents from modifying). Requires: VmWrite, Coordination.

capabilities.name: agent.release
capabilities.description: Release a previously claimed VM. Requires: Coordination.

capabilities.name: image.list
capabilities.description: List images in the fleet allowlist with their approval status. Read-only: approving an image is a human review step and is not reachable from here.

capabilities.name: image.get
capabilities.description: Look up one image in the allowlist by its registry reference.

capabilities.name: image.check
capabilities.description: Ask whether an image would be admitted, by SHA-256 digest. This is the question VM::provision asks before a VM starts.

capabilities.name: system.info
capabilities.description: Get HyperMachine system information. Declared with no required capability.

capabilities.name: system.health
capabilities.description: Get system health status. Requires: MetricsRead.

note: requires_grant is derived from the required_capabilities HyperMachine already declares per tool, against its own AgentCapabilities::read_only() set (VmRead, MetricsRead, StorageRead). A tool needing nothing outside that set needs no grant, which leaves ten: vm.list, vm.status, snapshot.list, vm.metrics, gpu.list, image.list, image.get, image.check, system.health and system.info. The classification is enforced rather than merely declared -- list_tools filters by the caller's capabilities, so a read-only agent cannot see the other twenty-three, and a test asserts vm.create and vm.delete are absent from that view. budgeted is the one axis HyperMachine does not declare, so it is judged here and stated rather than implied: a tool is budgeted when the caller supplies a quantity that determines its cost, or when it draws from a finite shared pool. vm.create and vm.resize take cpu_cores and memory_gb with declared maxima of 128 and 1024; snapshot.create consumes storage proportional to the VM; gpu.attach reserves a device from the fabric inventory; guest.exec runs an arbitrary command inside the guest; guest.file.write scales with content; agent.broadcast fans out across every connected agent. The remaining sixteen granted tools are single decisions, where the danger is that one was unauthorised rather than that many were made. system.info is declared with no required capability at all. That is HyperMachine's stated position, not an omission this manifest corrects, but it is the one entry worth a second look, since it is the only tool on a hypervisor reachable by an agent holding nothing.
